title: Shower Basket 18.75-Inch Oval Solid Brass Wall-Mounted | Glokzin Teal | Baskets Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Clear up shower clutter with a wall-mounted shower basket that keeps bottles, soap, and daily essentials organized and within reach in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. This oval shower basket (also called a shower caddy or shower shelf basket) adds distinctive, transitional style to the bath.

Highlights:
- Glokzin Teal transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Built for damp environments: solid brass construction with heavy-gauge wires is designed to never rust
- Clean installation look: concealed screw mounting hardware keeps fasteners out of sight
- Coordinate the room: part of the Baskets collection for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: shower basket / shower caddy / shower shelf basket
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 18.75 x 2.25 x 4.125 in.
- Material: solid brass (brass construction)
- Mounting: wall mount, wall-mounted, wall hanging with concealed screw mounting system
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 24 x 8 x 8 in.
- Shipping weight: 6 lbs
multiple designer finish options available
- Assembly: assembled in the U.S.A.
